patterns.note: Full-bleed photographic sections alternate with large-scale typographic statements, creating a visually impactful and immersive scrolling experience.

A highly condensed, bold sans-serif is used for dominant, large-scale headings and statements, providing strong visual impact, contrasted with a more standard, legible sans-serif for body text and smaller labels.
The design primarily uses a high-contrast black and white aesthetic, often inverted for different sections, with a deep, desaturated blue tint applied to the hero imagery.
Sections are revealed with a subtle fade-up or slide-in animation as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic flow as the user scrolls down the page.
Distinctive text animations are used for key headlines, including a glitch/distortion effect on the hero text and a word-by-word reveal for the final call-to-action.

technique_notes: The site employs a scroll-triggered animation system (likely GSAP ScrollTrigger) to orchestrate the reveal of full-width content sections. As each section enters the viewport, its constituent elements, such as images and text blocks, animate into view with a subtle fade-up or slide-in effect.

The hero section features a dynamic text animation where the headline text distorts and glitches as the user scrolls, eventually disappearing to reveal the next content. The background image in the hero also exhibits a subtle parallax scrolling effect.
A fixed navigation element (logo) and a call-to-action button remain sticky in the viewport corners throughout the scroll, providing persistent branding and interaction points.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, condensed sans-serif headings (~4-5x body) create strong visual statements, complemented by a legible, standard sans-serif for body text and labels.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with generous negative space around full-bleed images and large typographic elements, creating an airy and focused presentation.

standout: The site's distinctive use of dynamic text animations, particularly the glitching hero headline and the word-by-word reveal in the call-to-action, sets it apart. Combined with the full-bleed, high-contrast photography, it creates a highly engaging and memorable visual experience.
